local_scope: Tests only. The Firefox axeSource adapter changes only getIdrefsValue to prefer a nonempty attribute before reading a reflected element property. No app DOM, getter or runtime dependency is patched.
regression: Valid attribute ref is accepted without reading the failing getter
Missing attribute target is still reported as aria-dialog-name violation
Empty attribute with a valid reflected-element list remains supported
removal_condition: Use an official release containing the fix and remove the adapter after verifying all browser profiles.
